column2:
lack(n./v.)缺乏、缺少
lacking(adj.)缺乏的
lack of sleep 睡眠不足
lack confidence 缺乏自信
He is tired because of lack of sleep.
(他因為睡眠不足而很累。)
She lacks confidence when she speaks English.
(她說英文時缺乏自信。)

lady(n.)女士、淑女
(無詞性變化)
ladies and gentlemen 各位先生女士
old lady 老太太
Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the show.
(各位先生女士，歡迎蒞臨本節目。)
I helped an old lady cross the street.
(我幫一位老太太過馬路。)

ladybug(n.)瓢蟲
(無詞性變化)
red ladybug 紅色瓢蟲
ladybug spots 瓢蟲的斑點
A ladybug landed on my finger.
(一隻瓢蟲停在我的手指上。)
Ladybugs eat small insects on plants.
(瓢蟲會吃植物上的小蟲。)

lamb(n./v.)小羊、羔羊肉、生小羊
(無詞性變化)
roast lamb 烤羊肉
as gentle as a lamb 溫順如羔羊
The lamb is following its mother.
(那隻小羊跟著牠的媽媽。)
We had roast lamb for dinner.
(我們晚餐吃烤羊肉。)

lane(n.)巷子、小路、車道
(無詞性變化)
bus lane 公車專用道
fast lane 快車道
My house is in a quiet lane.
(我家在一條安靜的巷子裡。)
Cars cannot drive in the bus lane.
(汽車不能開進公車專用道。)

lantern(n.)燈籠、提燈
(無詞性變化)
Lantern Festival 元宵節
sky lantern 天燈
We saw many lanterns at the Lantern Festival.
(我們在元宵節看到很多燈籠。)
People release sky lanterns in Pingxi.
(人們在平溪施放天燈。)

lap(n.)膝上、(跑道的)一圈
(無詞性變化)
sit on one's lap 坐在某人腿上
run a lap 跑一圈
The cat is sleeping on my lap.
(那隻貓在我腿上睡覺。)
We ran three laps around the field.
(我們繞操場跑了三圈。)

latest(adj.)最新的、最近的
late(adj.)遲的、晚的
latest news 最新消息
the latest model 最新款
Have you heard the latest news?
(你聽說最新消息了嗎？)
He bought the latest model of the phone.
(他買了最新款的手機。)

latter(adj.)後者的、後半的
(無詞性變化)
the latter 後者
the latter half 後半
Of the two plans, I prefer the latter.
(這兩個計畫中，我比較喜歡後者。)
The latter half of the movie is exciting.
(這部電影的後半段很精彩。)

law(n.)法律、法則、定律
lawyer(n.)律師
lawful(adj.)合法的
break the law 犯法
by law 依法
Everyone must obey the law.
(每個人都必須遵守法律。)
Driving without a license is against the law.
(無照駕駛是違法的。)

lay(v.)放置、下(蛋)、鋪設
(無詞性變化)
lay eggs 下蛋
lay the table 擺餐具
Our hens lay eggs every day.
(我們的母雞每天都下蛋。)
She laid the baby on the bed.
(她把嬰兒放在床上。)

leadership(n.)領導能力、領導地位
lead(v.)帶領
leader(n.)領導者
leadership skills 領導技巧
under the leadership of 在……的領導下
She showed great leadership as class leader.
(她擔任班長時展現了出色的領導能力。)
The team won under his leadership.
(這支隊伍在他的領導下獲勝。)

leaf(n.)葉子、(書的)一頁
leaves(n.)葉子(複數)
fallen leaves 落葉
turn over a new leaf 改過自新
The leaves turn red in fall.
(葉子在秋天變紅。)
He promised to turn over a new leaf.
(他保證會改過自新。)

legal(adj.)合法的、法律的
illegal(adj.)非法的
legally(adv.)合法地
legal age 法定年齡
legal advice 法律諮詢
It is not legal to drive at sixteen here.
(在這裡十六歲開車是不合法的。)
You should get legal advice first.
(你應該先尋求法律諮詢。)

lend(v.)借出、借給
lender(n.)出借人
lend a hand 幫忙
lend money 借錢給人
Can you lend me your pen?
(你可以借我你的筆嗎？)
Could you lend me a hand with these boxes?
(你可以幫我搬這些箱子嗎？)

length(n.)長度、時間長短
long(adj.)長的
lengthen(v.)加長
at length 詳細地、最後
the length of …的長度
The length of the bridge is 500 meters.
(這座橋的長度是五百公尺。)
They talked about the plan at length.
(他們詳細地討論了這個計畫。)

lens(n.)鏡片、鏡頭、透鏡
(無詞性變化)
contact lens 隱形眼鏡
camera lens 相機鏡頭
She wears contact lenses instead of glasses.
(她戴隱形眼鏡而不是一般眼鏡。)
Don't touch the camera lens.
(不要碰相機鏡頭。)

liberal(adj.)開明的、自由主義的、大方的
liberty(n.)自由
liberate(v.)解放
liberal arts 人文學科
liberal attitude 開明的態度
My parents have liberal ideas about dating.
(我父母對交往的想法很開明。)
She studies liberal arts in college.
(她在大學讀人文學科。)

lid(n.)蓋子、眼瞼
eyelid(n.)眼皮
put the lid on 蓋上蓋子
jar lid 瓶蓋
Put the lid on the pot.
(把鍋蓋蓋上。)
I can't open the lid of this jar.
(我打不開這個罐子的蓋子。)

lift(v./n.)舉起、提起、搭便車、電梯(英)
(無詞性變化)
give someone a lift 讓某人搭便車
lift weights 舉重
Can you help me lift this box?
(你能幫我抬起這個箱子嗎？)
My dad gave me a lift to school.
(我爸爸順路載我去學校。)

likely(adj./adv.)可能的、很可能
likelihood(n.)可能性
unlikely(adj.)不太可能的
be likely to 很可能
most likely 極有可能
It is likely to rain tomorrow.
(明天很可能會下雨。)
He will most likely be late again.
(他極有可能又會遲到。)

limit(n./v.)限制、極限、限定
limited(adj.)有限的
limitation(n.)限制
speed limit 速限
time limit 時間限制
The speed limit here is 50 kilometers per hour.
(這裡的速限是每小時五十公里。)
Please limit your speech to three minutes.
(請把你的演講限制在三分鐘內。)

link(n./v.)連結、關聯、連接
(無詞性變化)
link between …之間的關聯
click the link 點擊連結
Click the link to watch the video.
(點這個連結觀看影片。)
There is a link between diet and health.
(飲食和健康之間有關聯。)

liquid(n.)液體
(無詞性變化)
liquid soap 洗手乳
clear liquid 透明液體
Water is a liquid at room temperature.
(水在室溫下是液體。)
You can't bring liquids on the plane.
(你不能帶液體上飛機。)

listener(n.)聽者、聽眾
listen(v.)聽
good listener 好的傾聽者
radio listener 電台聽眾
She is a good listener.
(她是很好的傾聽者。)
The radio show has many listeners.
(這個廣播節目有很多聽眾。)

liver(n.)肝臟
(無詞性變化)
liver cancer 肝癌
pork liver 豬肝
Drinking too much is bad for your liver.
(喝太多酒對肝臟不好。)
Grandma cooked pork liver soup for me.
(奶奶為我煮了豬肝湯。)

load(n./v.)負荷、裝載物、裝載
(無詞性變化)
heavy load 沉重的負擔
loads of 大量的
The truck carries a heavy load.
(那輛卡車載著沉重的貨物。)
They loaded the boxes into the car.
(他們把箱子裝上車。)

local(adj./n.)當地的、本地的、當地人
locally(adv.)在當地
local food 當地美食
local time 當地時間
We tried some local food in Tainan.
(我們在台南吃了一些當地美食。)
Ask a local for directions.
(向當地人問路吧。)

lone(adj.)孤單的、唯一的
lonely(adj.)寂寞的
alone(adj./adv.)獨自的
lone wolf 獨行俠
a lone tree 一棵孤零零的樹
A lone tree stood on the hill.
(山丘上有一棵孤零零的樹。)
He is a lone wolf and seldom joins others.
(他是個獨行俠，很少和別人一起行動。)

loss(n.)損失、喪失、失敗
lose(v.)失去、輸
lost(adj.)迷路的、遺失的
weight loss 減重
at a loss 不知所措
The team had a big loss last night.
(這支隊伍昨晚大敗。)
I was at a loss for words.
(我不知道該說什麼。)

lower(v.)降低、放下
low(adj.)低的
lower the price 降價
lower one's voice 壓低聲音
Please lower your voice in the library.
(在圖書館請壓低音量。)
The store lowered the price of the shoes.
(這家店調降了鞋子的價格。)

luck(n.)運氣、好運
lucky(adj.)幸運的
luckily(adv.)幸運地
good luck 祝好運
bad luck 壞運氣
Good luck on your exam!
(祝你考試順利！)
It was just bad luck.
(那只是運氣不好。)

magazine(n.)雜誌
(無詞性變化)
fashion magazine 時尚雜誌
read a magazine 看雜誌
She reads a fashion magazine every month.
(她每個月都看時尚雜誌。)
I saw your photo in a magazine.
(我在雜誌上看到你的照片。)

maintain(v.)維持、保養、主張
maintenance(n.)維修、保養
maintain a balance 維持平衡
maintain contact 保持聯絡
It is important to maintain a healthy weight.
(維持健康的體重很重要。)
He maintains his car very well.
(他把車子保養得很好。)

major(adj./n./v.)主要的、主修科目、主修
majority(n.)大多數
major in 主修
major problem 主要問題
She wants to major in history.
(她想主修歷史。)
Traffic is a major problem in big cities.
(交通是大城市的主要問題。)

male(adj./n.)男性的、雄性的、男性
female(adj./n.)女性的、女性
male student 男學生
male lion 公獅
The male lion has a big mane.
(公獅有一大圈鬃毛。)
There are more male students in this class.
(這個班的男學生比較多。)

manage(v.)管理、設法完成、management(n.)管理
manager(n.)經理
manage to do 設法做到
time management 時間管理
He managed to finish the work on time.
(他設法準時完成了工作。)
Good time management helps students study better.
(良好的時間管理有助於學生讀書。)

manager(n.)經理、經營者
manage(v.)管理
general manager 總經理
store manager 店長
I want to speak to the manager.
(我想和經理談談。)
She became a store manager at twenty-five.
(她二十五歲就當上了店長。)

mango(n.)芒果
(無詞性變化)
mango shaved ice 芒果冰
ripe mango 熟透的芒果
Mango shaved ice is popular in summer.
(芒果冰在夏天很受歡迎。)
This mango is sweet and juicy.
(這顆芒果又甜又多汁。)

manner(n.)方式、態度、(複數)禮貌
mannered(adj.)有……舉止的
table manners 餐桌禮儀
good manners 有禮貌
It's bad manners to talk with your mouth full.
(嘴裡有食物時說話是沒禮貌的。)
He spoke in a friendly manner.
(他以友善的態度說話。)

marriage(n.)婚姻、結婚
marry(v.)結婚
married(adj.)已婚的
happy marriage 幸福的婚姻
marriage proposal 求婚
My parents have a happy marriage.
(我的父母婚姻幸福。)
He made a marriage proposal at the beach.
(他在海邊求婚。)

marry(v.)結婚、嫁、娶
marriage(n.)婚姻
married(adj.)已婚的
get married 結婚
marry someone 和某人結婚
Will you marry me?
(你願意嫁給我嗎？)
They got married last spring.
(他們去年春天結婚了。)

mask(n./v.)面具、口罩、掩飾
masked(adj.)戴面具的
wear a mask 戴口罩
face mask 面膜、口罩
Please wear a mask on the bus.
(在公車上請戴口罩。)
He masked his fear with a smile.
(他用微笑掩飾恐懼。)

mass(n.)大量、團、質量、群眾
massive(adj.)巨大的
mass media 大眾傳播媒體
a mass of 大量的
The mass media has a strong influence on teens.
(大眾媒體對青少年影響很大。)
A mass of people gathered in the square.
(一大群人聚集在廣場上。)

master(n./v.)主人、大師、精通
mastery(n.)精通
master's degree 碩士學位
master a skill 精通一項技能
It takes years to master a language.
(精通一種語言需要好幾年。)
The dog waited for its master at the door.
(那隻狗在門口等牠的主人。)

mat(n.)墊子、地墊
(無詞性變化)
yoga mat 瑜伽墊
door mat 門口腳踏墊
Wipe your feet on the mat.
(在墊子上擦擦腳。)
I bought a new yoga mat.
(我買了一張新的瑜伽墊。)

match(n.)比賽、火柴、相配的人或物
(無詞性變化)
tennis match 網球比賽
a perfect match 天生一對、完美搭配
We watched a tennis match on TV.
(我們在電視上看了一場網球比賽。)
Your shoes and bag are a perfect match.
(你的鞋子和包包搭配得很完美。)

mate(n./v.)夥伴、配偶、交配
(無詞性變化)
find a mate 尋找伴侶
best mate 最好的朋友(英式口語)
My roommate and I get along well.
(我和室友相處得很好。)
Birds look for mates in spring.
(鳥類在春天尋找伴侶。)

material(n.)材料、資料、布料
(無詞性變化)
raw material 原料
teaching material 教材
This bag is made of soft material.
(這個包包是用柔軟的材料做的。)
She is collecting material for her report.
(她正在為報告蒐集資料。)

mature(adj.)成熟的
maturity(n.)成熟
immature(adj.)不成熟的
mature attitude 成熟的態度
mentally mature 心智成熟
He is very mature for his age.
(以他的年紀來說，他非常成熟。)
She handled the problem in a mature way.
(她用成熟的方式處理了這個問題。)

meaning(n.)意思、意義
mean(v.)意指
meaningful(adj.)有意義的
meaningless(adj.)無意義的
find meaning in 在……中找到意義
the meaning of life 人生的意義
What is the meaning of this word?
(這個字是什麼意思？)
Helping others gives my life meaning.
(幫助別人讓我的人生有意義。)

means(n.)方法、手段、財力
(無詞性變化)
by means of 藉由
by no means 絕不
The bus is the main means of transportation here.
(公車是這裡主要的交通工具。)
This is by no means easy.
(這絕不容易。)

measure(v.)測量、衡量、measurement(n.)測量、尺寸
(無詞性變化)
measure the length 測量長度
take measurements 量尺寸
The nurse measured my height and weight.
(護理師幫我量了身高和體重。)
The tailor took my measurements for a suit.
(裁縫師幫我量尺寸做西裝。)

medical(adj.)醫學的、醫療的
medicine(n.)藥、醫學
medic(n.)醫護人員
medical school 醫學院
medical care 醫療照護
She wants to go to medical school.
(她想讀醫學院。)
Taiwan has good medical care.
(台灣有良好的醫療照護。)

melody(n.)旋律、曲調
melodic(adj.)旋律的、悅耳的
sweet melody 甜美的旋律
catchy melody 朗朗上口的旋律
The song has a catchy melody.
(這首歌的旋律很好記。)
She hummed a simple melody.
(她哼著一段簡單的曲調。)

membership(n.)會員身分、會員資格
member(n.)成員、會員
membership card 會員卡
membership fee 會費
Show your membership card at the counter.
(在櫃台出示你的會員卡。)
The gym membership fee is not cheap.
(健身房的會費不便宜。)

memory(n.)記憶、回憶、記憶力
memorize(v.)記住
memorial(adj./n.)紀念的、紀念碑
good memory 好記性
in memory of 紀念
My grandma has a very good memory.
(我奶奶的記性非常好。)
I have happy memories of my childhood.
(我有許多快樂的童年回憶。)

mention(v./n.)提到、說起、提及
(無詞性變化)
don't mention it 不客氣
as mentioned 如前所述
Did he mention his new job?
(他有提到他的新工作嗎？)
'Thanks for your help.' 'Don't mention it.'
('謝謝你的幫忙。' '不客氣。')

message(n.)訊息、留言、要旨
messenger(n.)信差、傳訊者
leave a message 留言
text message 簡訊
Can I leave a message for her?
(我可以留言給她嗎？)
I sent you a text message last night.
(我昨晚傳了簡訊給你。)

metal(n./adj.)金屬、金屬的
metallic(adj.)金屬的
heavy metal 重金屬
metal box 金屬盒
Gold and silver are metals.
(金和銀都是金屬。)
The cookies come in a metal box.
(餅乾裝在金屬盒裡。)

meter(n.)公尺、計量器
(無詞性變化)
square meter 平方公尺
parking meter 停車計時器
The pool is 50 meters long.
(這座游泳池長五十公尺。)
He ran 100 meters in 12 seconds.
(他十二秒跑完一百公尺。)

method(n.)方法、方式
methodical(adj.)有條理的
teaching method 教學方法
scientific method 科學方法
This is a good method for learning words.
(這是學單字的好方法。)
We used a new method in the experiment.
(我們在實驗中使用了一種新方法。)

midnight(n.)午夜、半夜十二點
(無詞性變化)
at midnight 在午夜
midnight snack 宵夜
I went to bed after midnight.
(我過了半夜才去睡覺。)
Let's have a midnight snack.
(我們來吃宵夜吧。)

mile(n.)英里、哩
mileage(n.)里程數
miles away 遠在數英里外
miles per hour 每小時英里數
The beach is two miles from here.
(海灘離這裡兩英里。)
He walks three miles every day.
(他每天走三英里。)

military(adj./n.)軍事的、軍隊
(無詞性變化)
military service 兵役
military base 軍事基地
My brother is doing his military service.
(我哥哥正在服兵役。)
There is a military base near the coast.
(海岸附近有一個軍事基地。)

minor(adj./n.)較小的、次要的、未成年人
minority(n.)少數
minor problem 小問題
minor injury 輕傷
It's only a minor problem.
(這只是個小問題。)
He had a minor injury in the game.
(他在比賽中受了輕傷。)

minority(n.)少數、少數族群
minor(adj.)較小的
in the minority 屬於少數
minority group 少數族群
Only a minority of students voted no.
(只有少數學生投反對票。)
We should respect minority groups.
(我們應該尊重少數族群。)

mirror(n./v.)鏡子、反映
(無詞性變化)
look in the mirror 照鏡子
rearview mirror 後照鏡
She looked at herself in the mirror.
(她照鏡子看著自己。)
The lake mirrored the blue sky.
(湖面倒映著藍天。)

mix(n./v.)混合、混合物、相處
mixture(n.)混合物
mixed(adj.)混合的、複雜的
mix up 混淆、搞混
mixed feelings 百感交集
Mix the flour and the eggs together.
(把麵粉和蛋混在一起。)
I always mix up the twins.
(我總是把那對雙胞胎搞混。)

mixture(n.)混合物、混合
mix(v.)混合
a mixture of …的混合
cake mixture 蛋糕糊
Pour the mixture into the pan.
(把混合物倒進烤盤。)
I felt a mixture of joy and fear.
